what: Master Version 2.33 — the last four postwar sets on Lionel MPC-Modern go to Lionel PW - Sets. Two were already there under a wrong number: 2148B is corrected to 2149B (1949 Santa Fe 622 work train; the book and two boxed-set listings say 2149B) and 1538W to 1538WS (1955 2065 four-car passenger set), which also gets its missing fourth car, 2435 Elizabeth. Two are added at the bottom: 2222WS (1954 646 three-car passenger, $65) and 12502 (1962 Prairie-Rider Gift Pack). Then the four rows are removed from MPC-Modern.
stated: Brad (2026-10-12): "yes" to adding the four sets to PW - Sets and removing them from MPC-Modern; (2026-10-13) "yes" to the corrected plan (2 renumbers + 2 adds + 4 removals)

cells: Also 512. 2065 4-6-4 Hudson. 2046W streamlined whistle tender. 2432 Clifton Vista Dome, 2434 Newark Pullman, 2436 Summit observation. Silver-with-red-letter passenger cars. Handsome set. 1033 90-watt transformer.

Also 512. 2065 4-6-4 Hudson. 2046W streamlined whistle tender. 2432 Clifton Vista Dome, 2434 Newark Pullman, 2435 Elizabeth Pullman, 2436 Summit observation. Silver-with-red-letter passenger cars. Handsome set. 1033 90-watt transformer.

rows: 646 4-6-4 medium Hudson with headlight, smoke and Magne-traction. 2046W whistle tender. 2530 Railway Express Agency baggage car, 2532 Silver Range Vista Dome, 2531 Silver Dawn observation. Extruded-aluminum streamlined cars; a scarce version of the 2530 has larger doors.

Gift pack. 1862 4-4-0 General with headlight. 1862T tender. 3376 giraffe car, 1877 flatcar with horses (some packs came with a 6473 rodeo car instead), 1866 mail-baggage car, 1865 passenger car. No track or transformer. Original retail price not confirmed.
